lines.text: The waterfall had frozen into a wall of ice, and Tom walked right up to it for the photo.
Then a chunk broke off above him and hit the rocks a few feet away.
Frozen waterfalls can drop ice without warning, most of all when the sun warms them.
Water can still run under the ice at the base.
Take the photo from a distance, and stay off the ice.
Save this before your next winter hike.
